gloss_en: The Hebrew letter dalet (ד), fourth letter of the alphabet with numerical value four — as a symbolic entity in Likutey Moharan denoting Malkhut, which 'has nothing (de-leit) of her own,' and standing for fourfold structures (four kingdoms, four cups, four species, fourfold song, four corners/wings); the letter itself, not the homograph דֶּלֶת 'door'
